description: Defines classes and functions for handling fixed buffer input data in DER encoding, including the Input class for data referencing and ByteReader for bounds-checked reading.

classes.name: Input
classes.description: Represents a non-owning reference to a fixed buffer of data, with methods for accessing data and constructing from various sources.

classes.name: ByteReader
classes.description: Provides bounds-checked sequential reading of data from an Input object.

methods.name: Input()
methods.description: Default constructor creating an empty Input.

methods.name: Input(const uint8_t (&data)[N])
methods.description: Constructs Input from a fixed-size array.

methods.name: Input(const uint8_t* data, size_t len)
methods.description: Constructs Input from a pointer and length.

methods.name: Input(std::string_view sp)
methods.description: Constructs Input from a string view.

methods.name: Input(const std::string* s)
methods.description: Constructs Input from a string pointer.

methods.name: Length()
methods.description: Returns the size of the data buffer.

methods.name: UnsafeData()
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the data buffer (unsafe).

methods.name: AsString()
methods.description: Returns the data as a std::string.

methods.name: AsStringView()
methods.description: Returns a std::string_view of the data.

methods.name: AsSpan()
methods.description: Returns a base::span of the data.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks byte-wise equality of two Input objects.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks byte-wise inequality of two Input objects.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Lexicographical comparison of two Input objects.

methods.name: ByteReader(const Input& in)
methods.description: Constructor for reading data sequentially from an Input.

methods.name: ReadByte(uint8_t* out)
methods.description: Reads a single byte, returns false if no data left.

methods.name: ReadBytes(size_t len, Input* out)
methods.description: Reads multiple bytes into an Input, returns false if insufficient data.

methods.name: HasMore()
methods.description: Checks if more data is available to read.
